a11y: [Fixed] Builder tab order between the content detail panels and the content preview
[Fixed] Icon-only buttons missing accessible names across the builder, editor, settings, users and companies pages
[Fixed] Builder layout and rule editors not reflowing when the interface is zoomed or text is enlarged
editor: [Fixed] Missing translations on loading and save states for content, theme and project pages

a11y: [New] SDK tours meet WCAG 2.x operable criteria: focus loop within steps, skip-to-content bypass, focus returned on close and Escape to dismiss
[New] Screen reader announcements naming each step's target element, plus exit hints (EN/FR)
[New] Keyboard-accessible launchers with a visible focus ring and recovery when a host modal's focus trap skips them
[New] Shadow-root rendering of SDK content so screen readers no longer treat each step as a new page
[New] Accessible keyboard reordering of flow steps and checklist items in the builder
[New] Per-environment launcher focus settings to match the host app's modal focus trap, with optional timing overrides
[New] Focus trap detection in the debug bookmarklet
[Fixed] Flow, launcher and checklist builder findings from the a11y report, including inline validation messages announced to screen readers
environment: [New] Debug mode toggle in the bookmarklet, applied live without reloading the page
[New] Namespaced SDK debug loggers (content, launcher, iframe, conditions...) toggled from the bookmarklet

a11y: [New] Per-route page titles, a main landmark and a skip-to-content link across the admin app
[New] Page language kept in sync with the selected UI language
[Improved] Design-token contrast raised to meet WCAG 1.4.3 / 1.4.11, with visible keyboard focus on select options and tooltips
[Improved] Labelled navigation, sidebars, forms, dialogs, tables and filters across auth, content, users, companies and settings pages
[Improved] Heading structure corrected to one h1 per page with consistent section headings
[Improved] Theme editor controls made keyboard and screen reader accessible

editor: [New] Full French translation of the admin interface, builder and editor
[Improved] Debug bookmarklet now served from the Usertour server instead of an external link
[Fixed] Favicon not loading due to an incorrect asset path
iframe-sdk: [Fixed] Cross-frame messages (element found, step complete, step actions) not reaching registered handlers
environment: [Improved] Start script and nginx configuration updates for serving the bookmarklet

editor: [Improved] Usertour Helper embed link updated to force cache invalidation

launcher: [New] Icon picker supporting built-in Remix icon presets, URL-based icons, and custom uploads for greater launcher customization (merged from upstream)
[Fixed] "Perform action" flow assignment not persisted correctly in the editor

conditions: [New] Page Name condition allowing flows and launchers to trigger based on the current page name
[New] Mandatory condition enforced when auto-start is enabled on flows and launchers, improving trigger reliability
editor: [New] Skip step action added to the editor, allowing users to bypass steps or exit flows with controlled behavior
launcher: [Fixed] Overlay detection causing launchers to incorrectly be treated as hidden when covered by dynamic elements
[Improved] Launcher visibility detection for partially off-screen or dynamically rendered elements
[Fixed] Launcher detaching and reattaching incorrectly during scroll events
[Fixed] Launcher button action type not being saved correctly in the builder
environment: [Fixed] Docker layer and docker-compose.yml configuration issues affecting local environments

iframe-sdk: [New] Dedicated launcher rendering pipeline for iframe contexts with accurate positioning and scroll handling
[Fixed] Popper/tooltip positioning issues for elements inside scrollable iframes
[Fixed] Trigger conditions not consistently firing when driven by DOM or navigation events
environment: [Improved] Removed verbose debug logging from SDK core modules to improve runtime performance

conditions: [New] isVisible and !isVisible conditions supporting both main window and iframe contexts for more precise targeting
launcher: [Fixed] Launcher failing to attach to elements inside modals or dynamically rendered containers
[Improved] Attachment retry strategy for DOM element targeting, reducing premature or repeated retries
security: [Improved] Password reset emails also printed to terminal in development environments for debugging

editor: [New] Plugins page for installing selector tools and embedding the Usertour SDK
[Improved] Draft content visibility and environment handling in content listings
security: [Improved] Signup flow updates including routing fixes, stronger password requirements, and improved registration UX
environment: [Improved] Build configuration updates across apps/server and apps/sdk

iframe-sdk: [New] SDK support for content running inside iframes, including cross-frame communication utilities, selector parsing, and integration documentation
